item.content:encoded: I might be loopy because I didn't like anything until the "I got better" line but almost everything after that was highly enjoyable to me in my present state. This takes too long to get to the good stuff, consider consolidating everything in the first two tabs into one along with the stuff atop the tabs. Would make the time it takes for the piece to start being fun a lot shorter.

item.content:encoded:
An absolutely excellent read detailing a ☽☽☽ operation. Love seeing Janet again, as well as more fleshing out of the structure of ☽☽☽.

Favorite bit of humor:

Dell: And you don't resent your Pentatsar even slightly for this?

[Approx. 15 seconds of silence as the bishop tries to form a response.]

Ipatiev: I… got better?
